hook.text: Render from Rhino in one click

post.youtube_title: Free Rhino Jewelry Rendering Plug-in: Render From Rhino in One Click
post.caption:
Rhino jewelry rendering without exporting a file. Press HeyGema on the Rhino toolbar and your piece opens at your viewport's angle, ready to render in the metal and stones you pick.

Install it in Rhino: type PackageManager, search heygema and click Install.
Or download it here: https://www.heygema.com/en/rhino?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=yt-rhino-plugin-how-to

Chapters:
0:00 Send the piece from Rhino
0:29 Pick the metal and render
0:43 Changed the model? Press Update
1:03 Pick a stone in Rhino
1:28 More pieces from Rhino
1:55 What changes

In this video:
- Press HeyGema and the piece opens in its own window, at the same angle as your Rhino viewport.
- Pick the metal and click Render this view.
- Changed the model? Edit or hide it in Rhino and press Update. Your metal, stones and angle stay.
- Pick in Rhino: select the center stone in your viewport, then give it its own colour.

The plug-in is free for Rhino 7, 8 and 9, on Windows and Mac. Your .3dm stays on your computer; only pictures of the view you render are sent.

Sunburst necklace model: "Necklace b" by shah_max (sketchfab.com/shah_max), CC BY 4.0.
